title: Analyzing Feedback Without Overclaiming
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting analyzing feedback without overclaiming to storyboard frame sequence with narration, signaling, and reader-action notes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Scale claim strength to sample size and evidence type, distinguishing a candidate issue from a confirmed defect.
Replace evaluative language (hate, fails, proves) with counts of what was actually observed.
Separate a frequent signal from a severe one, and name which the evidence supports.
State the verification step a finding needs before it justifies a costly design change.
